name: Dustin Pintens
paragraphs: I enjoy writing poetry, especially about mental health awareness, which is very important to me. I also chased tornadoes professionally for almost three seasons. I'm good at thinking clearly in stressful situations, and I enjoy helping others however I can.

After my last divorce, I had to start over again. I lost everything and became homeless. My brother-in-law told me about Hope House. I was hesitant to come, but now I believe it was one of the best things I could have done for myself.

The fellowship here has helped restore my self-confidence in ways I could only have dreamed of before. Being around people moving forward has given me confidence to accomplish things of my own. I built the Pintens Quadflow 55, a four-way hopper that distributes soil into four 55-gallon drums at the same time.
I hold a full-time job, am buying a second vehicle, and have impressed the CEO of the company I work for. I'm very proud of my progress.
My next goal is to buy land and an RV, then eventually build a 30-by-40-foot shop and customize it into my home.
quote: My progress here is something I'm very proud of.
